verified_existing.comment: Q2 FY26 Services = $30.976 Mds (+16% YoY vs $26.645 Mds Q2 FY25). Q1 FY26 Services = $30.013 Mds (derive de YTD H1 $60.989 - Q2 $30.976). Stocke 23.9 Mds = stale (~Q4 FY24). Delta enorme (~30%). Hero KPI confirme.
H1 FY26 iPhone = $142.263 Mds (+22.7% vs $115.979 Mds H1 FY25). FY26 trajectoire annuelle estimee > $230 Mds. Stocke 209.586 (FY25) est obsolete vs run-rate FY26.
Q2 FY26 GM = $54.781/$111.184 = 49.3%. H1 FY26 GM = $124.012/$254.940 = 48.6%. Mix Services + pricing drive expansion. Stocke 46.9% sous-estime de ~2.4 ppt.
Coherent FY25 niveau annuel ~$34.55 Mds. A reactualiser quand 10-K FY26 dispo.
H1 FY26 net sales = $254.940 Mds (+16.1% vs $219.659 H1 FY25). Run-rate FY26 ~$460 Mds. Stocke $416 Mds = FY25 annuel - obsolete pour Q2 FY26.
